lines.zh: 我戴着那顶大头盔，走起来很沉。
lines.en: I wear that great helmet. It makes my walk heavy.

lines.zh: 头盔挡住视线，我只能往前。
lines.en: The helmet blocks my sight. I can only go forward.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走过来，甲片在响。
lines.en: I come on step by step, the helmet ringing.

lines.zh: 我的肩很宽，门要侧着过。
lines.en: My shoulders are broad; I turn sideways for doors.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，地面有脚印。
lines.en: My steps leave prints on the ground.

lines.zh: 我是这群里最硬的那个。
lines.en: I am the hardest of this group.

lines.zh: 我朝有光的地方一步一步走。
lines.en: I walk step by step toward the light.

lines.zh: 我的头盔上有几道深痕。
lines.en: There are deep dents in my helmet.

lines.zh: 我把手臂甩开，边走边扫。
lines.en: I swing my arms wide as I go.
I am not fast, but I never stop.
My helmet's shadow leaves the door before I do.

lines.zh: 我的骨架在盔甲里撑得很满。
lines.en: My frame fills the armor completely.
I stand, and the helmet hides everything.
It is dark in here. I do not need to see.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，盔甲在磕碰。
lines.en: I tilt my head and the armor knocks.
I listen for the direction of your breathing.

lines.zh: 我握了握拳头，指骨在盔里响。
lines.en: I clench; knuckles knock inside the plate.

lines.zh: 我没有血肉，盔甲只是壳。
lines.en: I have no flesh. The armor is only a shell.
I am angry. Always.
I wait for someone to come close.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，头盔影子拉长。
lines.en: I lower my head and the helmet's shadow stretches.

lines.zh: 我立在原地，甲缝里落灰。
lines.en: I stand still; dust settles in my armor's seams.
You stand before my helmet.
I cannot see you, but I know.
You are half a head shorter.

lines.zh: 这件盔甲本来不是我的。
lines.en: This armor was not mine to begin with.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指甲刮过盔沿。
lines.en: I raise a hand, nails scraping the rim.
Do not retreat. If you do, I follow.

lines.zh: 我里面全是骨头，没有别的。
lines.en: Inside I am all bone. Nothing else.
Your heartbeat is loud.

lines.zh: 我一直在生气，不知道为什么。
lines.en: I am always angry, and I do not know why.
If you have something to say, say it quickly.
A new dent in the helmet.
The armor gave. I did not.
I feel no pain. I only get angrier.
A plate came loose.

lines.zh: 这一下，打在我的肩甲上。
lines.en: That hit my pauldron.
I straighten my knocked-askew helmet.
A dent in my plate — not a deep one.
My bones are not broken.
I stay right here regardless.
Knock once more and see.
I cannot eat through this helmet.

lines.zh: 你把食物递给一具盔甲。
lines.en: You offer food to a suit of armor.
I have no mouth, only a jawbone.

lines.zh: 面甲挡住了，我咬不到它。
lines.en: The visor is in the way; I cannot bite it.
You hold it up. I do not look.
What I want is whoever blocks the way.
I knock the food to the floor.
You eat it. I will watch.
My anger needs no feeding.
Take that thing away.
You hit the armor. Your hand will hurt.
I lurch half a step and straighten up.
Move. I am slow, but heavy.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把我撞得更火了。
lines.en: That only made me angrier.
My pauldron is hard.
You bounced back a step.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，木板哼了一声。
lines.en: We collide, and the floorboards groan.
Do not walk at my side.
The moment my hand moves, you step back.
This armor of mine does not fear your charge.
There is only bone in this armor.
Such words are useless.

lines.zh: 我一直很生气，没空想这些。
lines.en: I am always angry. No time for this.
My kind have all scattered.
Do not say it beside my helmet.
I cannot remember who I was.
Someone else gave me this armor.
I need only an opponent.
You may leave now.
I will not answer that.

lines.zh: 我用盔甲的缝隙夹住它。
lines.en: I pinch it in a gap of my armor.
This is too small.
I squeeze once and it deforms.
I throw it down.
Iron. I know it.
I lift a rock.

lines.zh: 它掉进盔甲的缝里去了。
lines.en: It has dropped into a crack in my armor.
I knock it against my armor.
It rings brittle.
I keep it.

lines.zh: 你挪了脚步，盔甲听见了。
lines.en: You shifted your feet. The armor heard.
I heard your foot.
One and a half steps at this distance.
I turn my helmet toward you.
The anger is rising.
You did not run. That saves me the chase.

lines.zh: 我把手臂抬到胸口高度。
lines.en: I raise my arm to chest height.
There is no door behind you.
I need not see to hit.

lines.zh: 我一步步朝你的方向挪。
lines.en: I trudge toward where you are.
This blow must land squarely.
A wall behind you, a door to your left.
I raise my fist.
I have wanted to hit something for a long time.
You are right in front of my feet.
I make no sound; my footsteps are enough.
I press toward you.
I advance, and my plates clatter with each step.

lines.zh: 你退到哪，甲片声就在哪。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, my plates clatter after you.
My armor is loud.
No use hiding behind a pillar.

lines.zh: 我把整副甲的重量转向你。
lines.en: I turn the full weight of my armor toward you.
I sweep the table into the corner.
You move; I turn slowly.
I cannot see, but I hear.
Light footsteps will not help you.
I am counting how many breaths you take.
I seal the whole doorway with my shoulder.
The corner has you wedged.
I raise my hand above my helmet.
The anger grows heavier.
Three more steps and I am there.
If you stay still, I slow.
If you move, I quicken.
Only the two of us in this corner.
One step left.
My fist rises to the height of the doorframe.
My fist comes down and the floor breaks.
The helmet strikes you. Heavy.
I seize you and haul you up to my helmet.
This blow rings through the armor too.
The shield holds, but the body is knocked back.
One palm slams you into the wall.
That blow knocked a corner off the wall.
You fly out and topple a cabinet.

lines.zh: 我一个横扫，扫到了椅子。
lines.en: A sweep takes out a chair.
I do not tire. I only get angrier.
Still standing. Stubborn.
I lift one foot.
This blow is for those who block the way.
My gauntlet has split.
Step aside and this fist hits nothing.
The next fist will be heavier.
I push my helmet up out of the ground.
The armor is caked in soil.

lines.zh: 我撑起身体，甲片咔咔响。
lines.en: I push up, plates clanking.
The helmet is fitted tightly.
I cannot see, and need not.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指骨在盔里响。
lines.en: I raise a hand; bones knock inside.
There is the smell of the living.
I turn my head that way.

lines.zh: 这身甲是我从别人身上拿的。
lines.en: I took this armor from someone.
Now this armor is mine.
I walk toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我的怒气从第一刻就在。
lines.en: The anger was there from the first moment.
The brick splits in two under my foot.
Let me see who stands in front.

lines.zh: 盔甲被烧热了，骨头在里面发烫。
lines.en: The armor heats and my bones burn inside.
I fall and the armor digs a crater.

lines.zh: 水从盔缝灌进来，我沉了。
lines.en: Water pours through the seams and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，头盔飞了半圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me; the helmet spins.

lines.zh: 有东西撞在头盔上，弹开了。
lines.en: Something hits the helmet and glances off.

lines.zh: 咒力穿过盔甲，碰到骨头。
lines.en: A curse passes the armor and reaches the bone.
I am not hungry, but my bones grow light.

lines.zh: 雷打在头盔上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the helmet and numbs me all over.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，盔甲一直落。
lines.en: No ground below; the armor keeps falling.
